neighbours.label: a word of losing, dying or forgetting under negation (not lost on, not dead, not to lose, never forget)
fire: The irony of the situation was not lost on the audience.
Despite the rumours, the project is not dead yet.
Remember to hold the rail so you do not lose your balance.
The old tradition is far from dead in these villages.
His quiet kindness was not lost on his students.
She wrote the address down so she would not forget it.
Keep the receipt so you don't lose the warranty.
Rock music is not dead, it has simply moved underground.
quiet: The irony of the situation was obvious to the audience.
Despite the rumours, the project is going well so far.
Remember to hold the rail so you keep your balance.
The old tradition is still alive in these villages.
His quiet kindness was appreciated by his students.
She wrote the address down so she could find it later.
Keep the receipt so you can claim the warranty.
Rock music is popular, it has simply moved underground.

notes: probe: not lost 0.53, not dead 0.64, not to lose 0.46, never forget 0.14; positive counterparts ~0.01.
